text: Moving from the bright, almost clinical hallway into this vibrant, idea-soaked space fills me with curiosity and anticipation. The letters R+D promise creativity and innovation. I feel as though I’m stepping into a dialogue between the present and the possible, and the colorful display beckons me to engage deeper with these questions. The world here feels constructed for exploration and thought; I’m eager, yet strangely aware of the artificiality around me—a museum of thought, or a laboratory of potential.
